def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = next((c for c, _ in counts.most_common() if c != background), background)

    # Grid dividers are the rows/columns dominated by the second (divider) color.
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if sum(v == line_color for v in row) >= 0.7 * w]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.7 * h]

    result = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            r0, r1 = row_lines[ri], row_lines[ri + 1]
            c0, c1 = col_lines[ci], col_lines[ci + 1]

            if marker not in (background, line_color) and all(v == marker for v in corners):
                out_row.append(marker)
            else:
                out_row.append(background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
"
}

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = next((c for c, _ in counts.most_common() if c != background), background)

    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if sum(v == divider for v in row) >= 0.7 * w]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h)) >= 0.7 * h]

    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            r0, r1 = row_lines[ri], row_lines[ri + 1]
            c0, c1 = col_lines[ci], col_lines[ci + 1]
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            color = corners[0]
            if color in (background, divider) or not all(v == color for v in corners):
                color = background
            row.append(color)
        out.append(row)

    # Omit wholly blank outside rows/columns, retaining blank cells inside
    # the bounding rectangle of the marked tiles.
    marked = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row)
              if v != background]
    if not marked:
        return [[background]]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in marked)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in marked)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
